mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM asset_classify_client_auxiliary_lib p INNER JOIN (SELECT main_id AS id, MAX(version) AS version FROM common_version t1 WHERE t1.module = 'ASSET_CLASSIFY' AND t1.version_type = 1 GROUP BY main_id) m ON p.asset_classify_id = m.id AND p.version = m.version WHERE p.asset_classify_id = #{mainId}
